_doc: DENICOTEA dating cabinet (#53, Wave F, built 2026-07-17-eve). The Cologne/Bergisch-Gladbach ACCESSORY house (silica-gel filters, cigarette holders) that also sells pipes under fictional-Italian labels. Founded 1932 (Willy Heineberg). Corroborated by OUR archive work: Estonian Päevaleht ads Nov-Dec 1938 (eu_ft, 3 records) = 1930s international holder sales. SOURCES: staging/pipedia/Denicotea.json + eu_ft grading facts.

history_anchors._doc: 1932: Willy Heineberg founds DENICOTEA, Cologne — filters, filter inserts, cigarette holders, pipes. Post-WWII: HQ moves to BERGISCH GLADBACH. 'Denicotea' = properly the silica-gel FILTER name (holders + care products too); company + brand duality (today operated with COMPOSING-STUDIO GmbH). Our evidence: Estonian ads 1938 = pre-war international distribution. PIPE LABELS: ADSORBA = fantasy series by Luigi Crugnola for the German market (undated); ALDO MORELLI = fictional Italian name, trademark registered FEB 26, 1992 (DPMA) — pipes made by Cesare Barontini, Gigi, or Molina depending on line ('HAND CUT' stem imprint; kinship to 'Mauro Cateni', Gebr. Heinemann's fictional brand — same device); WESSEX also listed. ⚠️ ATTRIBUTION RULE: an Aldo Morelli is an ITALIAN-MADE pipe for a German distributor — never treat as an artisan brand.

brand_marks.physical: Denicotea = crystal/silica filter branding on holders + boxes; pipe labels carry the fictional names (Aldo Morelli w/ HAND CUT stem stamp).

line_years._notes: aldo morelli: DPMA registration 1992-02-26 = documentary floor. adsorba/wessex: undated -> unencoded.
